comment: A typed data-base lookup ('/' '?' dwarf) puts its corner NHW_TEXT window's --More-- on row 21, the first of three status rows. Unlike a menu's, this window's dismissal runs with bot() enabled, so erase_menu_or_text()'s docorner(offx, maxrow + 1, 0) clears row 21 from offx - 1, reprints the map at row ROWNO-1 there, and then calls bot() with disp.botlx set. bot() writes status line 1 over that row without erasing the corridor at column 76, past the end of the status text.
